name: cf-vibe
description: Run one command from a GitHub issue or feature request to a reviewed, ready pull request, and to a merge only with --ship. It chains worktree, plan, implementation or fix, review, tests, docs, PR, and PR review fixes through the existing CafeKit skills, taking the user's gates for that one run. Use when: Invoke when the user personally asks for one command that takes a GitHub issue or feature request through planning, implementation, PR review, and optionally merge and CI convergence.
